name: Stencil & Tablet
avoid_for: Contexts that demand digital-native polish or playful pop — the stencil-cut display and earth-tone palette commit to a deliberate analog feel
weak_cases: Long prose competes with giant numerals; busy tablets can obscure distinctions between metrics.
visual_signature: Stencil-scale type and saturated rounded tablets make color blocks the layout.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: Stencil breaks and condensed uppercase are Latin-specific identity cues; substitution changes the voice and needs preview.

assets.images: No image required; type, shapes and surface treatments can carry the system.
